items.question: By what count and in what contexts are certain beings said to endure torment?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the contexts in question.
Those contexts are identified as thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings situated there are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places where beings are tormented.
